recommendations.rule: Recommendations must come from real first-degree connections with firsthand basis. Never fabricate or pre-attribute testimony.

open_to_work.rule: Do not invent location, workplace, or employment preferences. Populate only from explicit operator choices.

identity_verification.rule: Use LinkedIn's currently available identity-verification flow when eligible; do not represent verification as complete until LinkedIn confirms it.

portfolio_gateway.purpose: Single recruiter conversion surface above individual GitHub repositories.
